build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs for sequence labeling
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph with nodes and arcs for all class pairs
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping features to output classes
sample_crf_sequences: sample sequences from a trained CRF model using Viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss by composing feature graphs and computing forward scores
